title: Lancaster Ice Rink
specs: Players must register online with a valid USA Hockey registration number
Selection based on official evaluation sessions performance
Players agree to play exclusively for Lancaster Firebirds for the season once evaluated
includes: Weekly professional coaching with Hockey Director Chris Campanale
Twelve 1-hour goaltender training sessions during the season
AHF player registration fee included in season cost
gap: Price amounts for each age group and package not stated
blurb: Lancaster Ice Rink hosts youth hockey teams with weekly professional coaching and goaltending development sessions. They organize tryouts and evaluations for various age groups from 6U to 18U. The rink supports player development through structured practices and skill-focused training.
extraNote: No refunds on player tuition; releases considered only if tuition fully paid · Accounts must be current to participate; delinquent accounts may lead to suspension · Financial assistance available via Chad Neiss II Memorial Scholarship Fund
